data.one_liner: A benchmark harness for performance-testing Flutter web apps in Chrome.
data.what_it_does: Provides a client and server harness to performance-test Flutter web applications inside Chrome. It automates running benchmarks, extracting performance traces, and analyzing or comparing results.
use_when: You need to performance-test Flutter web applications in Chrome
You want to compute deltas or averages between multiple benchmark runs
avoid_when: You are testing mobile or desktop apps rather than Flutter web
You want to run benchmarks in browsers other than Chrome
strengths: Automates extracting performance traces and metrics from Chrome
Supports analyzing and comparing benchmark results with built-in delta and average computations
weaknesses: Currently only supports running benchmarks in Chrome
Requires setting up both a client and a server harness
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up a client benchmark code piece and a server to serve the app's code, assets, and communicate with the browser.
